title: Sound in the card: a levelled catalogue, beds under the voice, a Sound control
acceptance: The remaining sound catalogue is levelled to a stated loudness band, measured through the real engine.
The card's Chamber plays beds and tones, ducked under the voice.
A Sound on/off control in the card's Settings.
The premium-educational guide teaches one quiet bed.
The voice trace notes the bed.

evidence.note: The eleven Feelings sounds are parked (#558, #562); this task levels what remains.
Revised 2026-10-09: Claude first, the critical path to the Composer release, and this task's place on it.
Measured through the real engine (layer 0.85, master 0.7, 25 s from t=3 s): all sixteen offered sounds between -29.2 and -28.8 dBFS RMS with their trims; before trimming they spanned -53.2 to -11.5.
Every offered sound has a trim, no parked sound has one, and every manifest entry was measured with the shipped trim and is inside the band.

Trims on soundscapes and tones without changing the configured volume; ducking from the target level during a fade-in and for a bed started under the voice; onSoundStart and sounding; init completes with one warning where indexedDB.open throws SecurityError.
[RISE audio] line per bed and tone, __riseLive.audio(); ducked on speech.start, released on speech.end, voice.failed, voice.taken, voice.held; not ducked when paced; engine released at the end.
Sound row only with an engine; a switch, on by default, off and on through the Chamber and saved as cardSound; a saved off silences the next reading.

Local Chromium, one worker, whole file: 46 passed. New: in the opaque-origin self-contained card, starlight starts within 5 s of Play, Pause then Play keeps it, Sound off stops it, on restores it. Fails without the IndexedDB guard. Fake host, paced voice.
SND-001 pull request; not merged at the time of this record.
